items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Don Roby ... had bought some dates on Sam Cooke ... and he wanted a band to back him and somehow or another my name came up ... I told her yes. I had done work for them before

ctx.x: What you're looking at now, that's when maybe I kind of went on society type dates at home. I didn't travel. I'll show you the one I'm talking about.
